## Natural history notes

A tiny damselfly characterized by its extremely slender body, delicate clear wings, and metallic green to bluish coloration with fine dark markings along the abdomen. In Florida, it is found in marshes, wet prairies, pond edges, sloughs, and other shallow freshwater wetlands with dense grasses, sedges, and emergent vegetation. Adults perch low and quietly among fine vegetation while hunting tiny flying insects, and the aquatic nymphs live among submerged plants where they feed on small aquatic invertebrates.
